python -c "
from glom import Check, T, RAISE
# Basic Check
print('Basic:', repr(Check()))
# With spec
print('With spec:', repr(Check(T['a'])))
# With default
print('With default:', repr(Check(equal_to=0, default='n/a')))
# With validators
print('With validators:', repr(Check(validate=lambda x: x > 0)))
# With instance_of
print('With instance_of:', repr(Check(instance_of=int)))
# With types
print('With types:', repr(Check(type=(str, int))))
# With vals (equal_to)
print('With equal_to:', repr(Check(equal_to='hello')))
# With vals (one_of)
print('With one_of:', repr(Check(one_of=(1, 2, 3))))
" 2>&1
